text: my u loop is not concave. or convex. it was just a flat set of faces so ?
resolution: Terminology question only, no code: explained that convex/concave in the merge rule describes the 2D OUTLINE of the fused face within its flat plane (rectangle = convex, U/horseshoe = concave because the notch corners turn inward), not 3D surface curvature — the user's faces being flat is expected and separate. Also explained why the outline shape matters mechanically: a merged face is stored as its outline loop and rebuilt by fanning triangles from one corner, which only stays inside a convex outline; fanning a notched outline would bridge across the hole, which is why the horseshoe cannot re-tessellate and now refuses.
